aiDescriptions.n: Tableau Agent drafts descriptions for data sources, workbooks and tables in Catalog (Cloud). Tableau Next has a Beta generator.

bulkMetadata.n: REST: Update Column, Batch Add Tags, and from API 3.30 field descriptions on a work copy. Needs Data Management.

autoClassify.n: Sensitivity labels and tags are set by hand or via REST. No automatic column classification found.

sampleValues.n: Tableau Agent sends up to 1000 unique sampled values from the data source to the model when authoring vizzes.

queryHistory.n: No feature mines usage or query logs to suggest models or metrics. Tableau Agent drafts descriptions from the data source.

lineage.n: Catalog lineage filters to a selected field or column, upstream or downstream. No columns for custom SQL tables. Cubes unsupported.

evals.n: Q&A Calibration (Beta) in Tableau Next tests questions in Concierge, then lets you verify and calibrate results.

vendors.enrichHowTo: With a Data Management license, call Update Column to set one column description at a time, or use the REST API 3.30 data source methods to create a work copy, add FieldDescription and TableDescription elements, then publish it. Batch Add Tags tags many assets in one call. In Tableau Next, turn on the Semantic Description Generator (Beta) and review each draft.

Step 4: Enable Tableau Next AI Features

aiDescriptions.n: SpotterModel drafts column descriptions from a chat prompt; autonomous build is Beta. AI synonyms are Early Access.

bulkMetadata.n: TML API exports and imports Model TML in bulk, with column descriptions and synonyms. Column property sync is Early Access.

autoClassify.n: No automatic PII tagging found. Docs advise excluding PII columns from indexing by hand.

sampleValues.n: Indexing samples 1,000 values per column and powers Spotter value suggestions and column sample values. Secure suggestions fetch values live.

queryHistory.n: No feature builds models or examples from warehouse query logs. Memory comes from Liveboards and conversations (Early Access).

lineage.n: Tables list dependent Models, Liveboards and Answers and the columns they use. DataHub builds column lineage.

evals.n: Add to Coaching saves verified question and answer pairs. The Spotter Conversations Liveboard shows feedback. No benchmark runner found.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Export the Model as TML with the TML API, edit column descriptions, synonyms and AI context in the file, then import it back with the import API. Use Generate under Spotter optimization to draft AI context per column, review it, and use the Spotter diagnose prompts to find confusing columns.

bulkSnippet.code:
{
 "metadata_tmls": [
 "guid: <model_guid>
model:
  name: <model_name>
  columns:
  - name: <column_name_1>
    description: <column_description>
    properties:
      synonyms:
      - <synonym>
"
 ],
 "import_policy": "PARTIAL",
 "create_new": false
}

aiDescriptions.n: No description generator found. The Assistant index builds its own descriptions from column names and does not write them back.

bulkMetadata.n: Data model spec API replaces whole models as JSON or YAML, with column descriptions. dbt persist_docs also feeds them.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification in the docs. Column-level security rules are set by hand.

sampleValues.n: Docs describe the Assistant index as built from names, descriptions and generated synonyms. No sampled values documented.

queryHistory.n: Usage dashboards report query statistics for admins. No feature turns them into models or examples.

lineage.n: Lineage graph and lineage API are element level: tables, joins, charts, controls. Column-level lineage is not described in the docs.

evals.n: Agent evaluation suites run from input tables or the REST API, using AI_USAGE records. Assistant has response feedback.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Get the data model with GET /v2/dataModels/{id}/spec, edit table, column and metric descriptions in the JSON or YAML, then send the full spec back with PUT /v2/dataModels/{id}/spec, since partial updates are not supported. Descriptions can also come from warehouse comments or dbt with persist_docs. Add AI context (Beta) for Assistant instructions.

aiDescriptions.n: No AI description generator found. Synonyms, column context and DataSet context in AI Readiness are written by hand.

bulkMetadata.n: API sets DataSet description and tags. Column descriptions are edited per DataSet in the UI or synced from Snowflake.

autoClassify.n: No column classification found. PII Vault, a partner product with Anonomatic, redacts PII at upload.

sampleValues.n: AI Readiness uses descriptions, synonyms and column context you write. No value sampling documented; the Beast Mode assistant sends only schema.

queryHistory.n: Activity Log records usage for admins. No feature mines it to suggest models or examples.

lineage.n: Native lineage is DataSet, DataFlow, card and alert level. A column-level lineage agent app is listed on Domo's site.

evals.n: No eval set tooling found. AI Playground tests prompts against a DataSet, and AI Chat has a feedback option.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Open the AI Readiness tab on each DataSet, add DataSet context, synonyms and column context, and switch on AI Enabled for the columns Domo AI should use. If column descriptions live in Snowflake, ask your Domo account team to turn on Schema tab metadata sync. Governance Toolkit Tag Management jobs apply tags to many DataSets at once.

aiDescriptions.n: Ask Metabot in chat to write descriptions. It only sees database content, so it cannot supply business context.

bulkMetadata.n: No native bulk edit. Scripts call PUT /api/table/{id} and PUT /api/field/{id}; the community dbt-metabase package does this from dbt.

autoClassify.n: Sync and fingerprinting assign semantic types to columns automatically. No PII or sensitivity tagging found.

sampleValues.n: Metabase sends sampled field values to the AI, so Metabot can check if a state is WI or Wisconsin.

queryHistory.n: Metabot keeps only the current conversation. Nothing mines past queries to suggest models or examples.

lineage.n: Dependency graph links questions, models, metrics, dashboards, transforms and their source tables. No column-level lineage is described.

evals.n: Thumbs feedback on Metabot answers goes to Metabase, not into verified examples. No eval set tooling found.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Edit table and field descriptions in Data Studio, Connected data, and ask Metabot to draft them. To write descriptions at scale, run a script or the dbt-metabase package after each dbt run, calling PUT /api/table/{id} and PUT /api/field/{id}. Define business terms in the Glossary, which Metabot reads.

aiDescriptions.n: No built-in AI description feature found. The MCP service added in 6.1 lets an external agent work with Superset.

bulkMetadata.n: superset export_datasources and import_datasources move datasets as YAML, with column and metric descriptions. Docs are for Superset Next.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification in the README feature list.

sampleValues.n: No built-in NL-to-SQL found in the docs or 6.1 notes, so no value matching. MCP clients bring their own model.

queryHistory.n: No feature mines query history to suggest joins, metrics or examples in the README or MCP docs.

lineage.n: Dataset related-objects lists the charts and dashboards that use a dataset. No column-level lineage found.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL feature, so no eval tooling found.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Export datasets with superset export_datasources, edit the column and metric description fields in the YAML, and import them back with superset import_datasources. The same data model is available over the REST API. Superset has no AI description feature, so draft descriptions elsewhere and load them this way.

bulkSnippet.code:
superset export_datasources -f datasources.zip
# edit column descriptions in the exported YAML, then rezip
superset import_datasources -p datasources.zip

notes.text: The page for AI context on data models says it describes public beta features that may change. Sigma datasets can no longer be used as a data source since 2026-09-15, so use data models.

notes.text: ThoughtSpot deprecated Worksheets in 10.4.0.cl (Nov 2024) and removed them in 10.12.0.cl (Aug 2025). Existing Worksheets were migrated to Models, so edit Model TML.
Tableau Cloud help calls the assistant Tableau Agent. Tableau Next setup pages still use Agentforce for Analytics, with Concierge, Data Pro and Semantic Model Curation.
